title: Fabric ↔ FluxVM DevOps probe contract
description: Load-balancer and CI gates must use these paths and fields. Keep in sync with zyvorai/fluxvm docs/contracts/fabric-fluxvm-readyz.json.

readyz.ok_rule: ok == store && fluxvm.ok (FluxVM body is nested under fluxvm)

readyz.notes: dataplane may report schema_version 9 locally; Fabric proxies aggregate DataplaneStats until FluxVM exposes per-direction ppstat on REST. Catch-up fields: status.pod_ingress_required/attached, stats.pod_policy; QGA under /v1/vms/{id}/qga/*; migration receivers under /v1/migration/receivers.
